History of Present Illness:
Mr. [CLAIMANT] is a 44 year old male who presents for an independent medical evaluation regarding a work injury sustained at [EMPLOYER].
The patient reports the injury occurred on [DATE D+0] while performing duties as an order picker.
He describes the mechanism of injury as lifting a plastic tote from a floor level pallet to a cart.
The examinee reports lifting a tote of about 60 pounds.
He states he experienced immediate low back pain following the incident.
He acknowledges a [YEAR Y-6] episode of low back pain that resolved.
The pain has been intermittent since the reported incident.
Current complaints include localized lower back pain and stiffness.
He reports difficulty with prolonged sitting and bending.
